$schema: Citizen + leader traits (spec §5, §6). Citizens roll 0-1 traits at birth for flavour + a light modifier. Leaders earn one trait per level-up. Modifiers are a data bag read by systems: gatherMult (citizen gather speed), moraleBonus, loyaltyBonus, xpMult; leader: revealBonus (fog radius), knowledgePerDay, rallyBonus (interact morale), reputation hint.
